usageNotes: Triggers an `apt-get update` on the specified remote PVE node to refresh its package index; run this before querying available upgrades or installing packages. The operation is asynchronous — the response is a remote UPID that must be polled for completion status before acting on the updated package list. The caller requires the `Resource.Modify` privilege on the target remote/node/system path.

examples.summary: Refresh APT package index on node pve1 of the prod-cluster remote

tips: The returned UPID is a 'remote UPID' (minimum 42 chars) — use the appropriate task-status endpoint to poll completion before querying apt/versions or triggering an upgrade.
Node name accepts 'localhost' as a special value when PDM itself is the target node.
No body parameters are required; send an empty JSON object ({}) as the request body.
